performance.verdict: Organic holding a quiet account; paid is fully dark, not paused-light.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — Meta and Google Ads show $0 spend and 0 leads; this account is fully dark on paid, not merely underperforming.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 in the last 7 days (−100% delta) after peaking at 11 on 2026-08-24; the local profile is losing organic discovery momentum.
GA4 sessions spiked to 28 on 2026-09-01 — the 3-day signal (Sep 1–3: avg 14.3 vs Aug 29–31: avg 5.0) is a +186% lift, but source is unknown without paid or GBP activity explaining it.
GA4 records 213 sessions and 173 users over 28 days but 0 conversions, confirming no intake funnel is active or tracking conversion events correctly.

suggestions.text: Investigate why Meta and Google Ads have $0 spend for 28+ days — confirm campaign status and billing before any budget action.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta and Google Ads have recorded $0 spend across all 28 days with 0 leads, confirmed in both totals and the full 45-day series. Check campaign pause status, billing account standing, and ad approval state for both channels. Success is confirmed when at least one channel logs >$0 spend on two consecutive days. Resolve and report back by 2026-09-09.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP profile — 0 actions last 7 days after 11 actions on Aug 24; check suspension, ownership, or listing issue.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped −100% in the last 7 days, falling to 0 after a peak of 11 on 2026-08-24. Log into Google Business Profile and confirm the listing is verified, not suspended, and has no pending owner conflicts. Success is 5+ GBP actions recorded in a 7-day window. Re-check 2026-09-13.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 session trend: 3-day avg is 14.3 vs prior 5.0; identify traffic source before attributing or acting.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions spiked to 28 on 2026-09-01 and the 3-day average (Sep 1–3) is 14.3 vs 5.0 the prior 3 days — a +186% lift with no paid or GBP activity to explain it. Pull GA4 source/medium breakdown to identify the channel driving this traffic. If the source is identifiable and sustainable, flag for budget planning. Re-check 2026-09-09.
